p: One time Rabbi Yishmael ben Loga related to me:
One time I and one of the descendants … went out to the field to collect herbs, … and I saw that he laughed and he cried.
One time I and one of the descendants of the House of Avtinas went out to the field to collect herbs, and I saw that he laughed and he cried.
I said to him: … Why did you cry? … He said to me: … I was reminded of the honor of my forefathers, … And why did you laugh?
